slides.title: Installing your updates
slides.text: qTrace downloads the new versions you accepted, then asks you to restart QuPath once.

done.title: Updates downloaded
done.text: Every new version has been delivered. It starts the next time you open QuPath.

partial.title: Some updates did not arrive
partial.text: The ones marked ! could not be downloaded. The others have been delivered and start the next time you open QuPath.
